clips.title: The story
paras: Jordan Stilwell is a skilled human weaponsmith stationed outside the snowy Gates of Ironforge in Dun Morogh. Though originally meant to become a paladin of the Holy Light, he followed his father's craft to become an artisan whose work serves paladins across the Alliance. He is best known for forging Verigan's Fist in honor of his old friend, Bosch Verigan.

Though Jordan Stilwell was expected to take holy vows and become a paladin within the Church of the Holy Light, he ultimately chose the way of the forge. He followed in his father's footsteps, taking up his father's enchanted smithing hammer. Jordan refined his craft under the tutelage of the dwarven blacksmith Bailor Stonehand. Despite setting aside the mantle of an anointed holy warrior, Jordan remains deeply faithful to the Light, dedicating his extraordinary craftsmanship to outfitting champions who fight in its name.

Long before setting up shop in the biting cold of Dun Morogh, Jordan served as a smith at the keep of Baron Silverlaine in Silverpine Forest. When Archmage Arugal unleashed the feral worgen upon the fortress, turning it into the cursed bastion known as Shadowfang Keep, Jordan managed to escape the bloodshed. Forced to abandon his forge and his former home, he eventually found refuge among the dwarves of Dun Morogh.
